verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm that runs client-facing digital workflows through its Clerky partnership, so it is fair to ask whether users can control retention and deletion of their data. The pack contains no evidence of any such user-facing control. The Data Privacy practice page describes legal advice on embedding privacy into clients' own infrastructure, which is an adjacent advisory service and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
